statement: Raw HTML payloads of every public pricing page transcribed into price_snapshot.json or MODAL_APPENDIX.md, archived for offline verification. Each transcribed unit price is present verbatim in its payload (grep-verifiable without network). Fetched with curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64)'.

archives.binds_records: MODAL_APPENDIX.md only; Modal has no price records by design
